candidate_policy: report every frozen DINOv3 axis, timing, design, and comparison; no best-cell filtering

bootstrap.pairing: same outer-fold OOF patient and identical resample weights

dinov3_vs_dinov1.rule: both populations; matched GLOBAL/LOCAL; full mri_only,mri_clinical; complete mri_only_paired,mri_clinical_paired,mri_ftv,mri_clinical_ftv; all timings

local_vs_global.rule: DINOv3 LOCAL minus GLOBAL; both populations; all DINOv3 designs; all timings

dinov3_vs_current_cnn_full.rule: full cohort only; GLOBAL minus GAP0 and LOCAL minus LOCAL0; mri_only,mri_clinical; all timings

clinical_gain.rule: DINOv3 mri_clinical minus clinical-only; both populations; both axes; all timings

beyond_ftv.rule: complete-case DINOv3 mri_clinical_ftv minus clinical_ftv; both axes; all timings

inference_scope: post-hoc descriptive paired OOF bootstrap; not confirmatory
